title: The Circumcision of the Heart
edition: Printed in the 1771 Works. Preached at Saint Mary's, Oxford, before the University, on 1 January 1733.
blurb: Rendered in modern English, to be read and heard. Open the 1771 text under each part to check the claims and the scripture.
era_note: John Wesley lived from 1703 to 1791. This sermon is in his 1771 Works. He preached it at Saint Mary's, Oxford, before the University, on 1 January 1733. It is an English sermon, not an ante-Nicene father.

text_history.method: Rendered in modern English. The 1771 panel is his own Pine printing of the Works. It is public domain.
text_history.identifiers: Sermon 17 in the 1771 Works. Romans 2:29. Saint Mary's, Oxford, 1 January 1733.
